name: Tebalja
title: A Levite Who Left His Foreign Wife
summary: Tebalja was one of the Levites mentioned in connection with Ezra's reforms after returning from exile in Babylon. He was among those who had taken foreign wives in violation of God's law and were required to separate from them to preserve the religious purity of the people.

keyEvents.title: Listed Among the Levites with Foreign Wives
keyEvents.description: Tebalja was mentioned among the Levites who had married women from foreign nations, which was contrary to the Law of Moses.

keyEvents.title: Ezra's Public Reading of the Law
keyEvents.description: Ezra read the law to the people, and it became clear that many, including Levites like Tebalja, had broken the covenant by taking foreign wives.

keyEvents.title: The People's Pledge to Repent
keyEvents.description: The people, including the Levites, made a pledge to follow God's law and separate from their foreign wives.

keyEvents.title: The Investigative Commission Is Appointed
keyEvents.description: A commission was appointed to investigate all cases of marriage with foreign women, and the Levites' cases were handled separately.
